Hey everyone! My boyfriend and I are an Israeli-Argentinian couple, starting the process to apply for my partner visa! I have a few questions, although I think I’ve gotten an idea of the answers from other posts.
1- I’ve heard from lawyers that it’s better to start the visa process from Israel. I’m currently living in Argentina, my boyfriend’s living in Israel. Would it make the paperwork move faster if I was there already or could I potentially have trouble from it?
2- Is it recommended to hire a lawyer for the process?
3- I think we should apply in Jerusalem, how long are they usually taking to answer?

Thank you all!
🇦🇷🇮🇱
